title: Intermediate states in a round
statement:
Let $M$ be a $k$-work-tape Turing machine, let $a$ be a state, let $E$ be a set of optional states, and let $P$ be a property of work-head positions. If $c$ and $c'$ form a round of duration $t$, then at every time $u$ with $0<u<t$, the machine is in some state $s$ with $s
e a$ and whose optional state is not in $E$.
hypotheses_covered: $E$ is a set of optional states
$P$ is a property of work-head positions
